metadata.name: baseline-placeholder-calibration
metadata.description: Executable baseline values for the dairy ABM. Defaults marked assumption=true require later calibration before scientific use.

cross_diet_repeatability_modifier.description: Midpoint default for cross-diet RFI expression repeatability.

minimum_intake_record_days.description: Minimum continuous intake records before reliable RFI_fat assignment.

annual_rfi_gain_fraction.description: Midpoint of supported annual gain range for RFI-supported traits.

selection_intensity.description: Share of eligible breeding candidates selected each annual cycle.

phenotypic_sd_rfi_fat.description: Phenotypic standard deviation scaled to the blueprint's annual 0.75-1.0 percent RFI gain target.

generation_interval_years.description: Generation interval required to annualize breeder-equation gain.

offspring_trait_variation_fraction.description: Seeded random variation around the parental mean for prospective offspring trait vectors.

feed_cost_stress_threshold_per_kg_dm.description: Feed-cost signal threshold that increases feed-efficiency selection emphasis.

feed_efficiency_weight_multiplier_under_.description: Feed-efficiency weight multiplier applied when feed cost exceeds the configured stress threshold.

disease_frequency_stress_threshold.description: Disease-pressure threshold that increases health selection emphasis.

health_weight_multiplier_under_disease_s.description: Health weight multiplier applied when active disease cases exceed the stress threshold.

high_cull_price_threshold.description: Cull-price threshold above which livability receives additional breeding emphasis (blueprint 4.4: a high cull price or mortality raises livability). Set above the workbook cull value of 800.

survivability_weight_multiplier_under_hi.description: Livability weight multiplier applied when the cull-price signal is high or cows have died.

milk_yield.description: Baseline breeding-index weight for milk production.

feed_efficiency.description: Baseline breeding-index weight for low RFI and feed efficiency.

health.description: Baseline breeding-index weight for disease resilience.

enteric_ch4_kg_per_cow_day.description: Baseline enteric methane emission before feed-efficiency adjustment.

ch4_me_reference_constant.description: Herrero-derived ME reference constant in the enteric CH4 intensity approximation (ch4_per_litre = base_ch4 x (10.5 / ME)).

heat_stress_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction when heat stress is active.

initial_age_days.description: Default age assigned to a simulated cow when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_days_in_milk.description: Default lactation day assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_parity.description: Default completed-lactation count assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_body_weight_kg.description: Default body weight assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

bodyweight_first_parity_kg.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) DEFAULTS_ANIMAL bodyweight_first_parity_kg (docs/parity/conventional_dashboard_target.html). No Blueprint or workbook value; the Blueprint's NASEM Eq 2-1 support data give BW 624 +/- 80.2 kg (Cow agent 8.1).
bodyweight_first_parity_kg.description: Baseline body weight of a first-parity cow; the parity baseline rises linearly to bodyweight_mature_kg at herd.mature_parity. Owner decision 2026-09-23.

bodyweight_mature_kg.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) DEFAULTS_ANIMAL bodyweight_mature_kg (docs/parity/conventional_dashboard_target.html). No Blueprint or workbook value; the Blueprint's NASEM Eq 2-1 support data give BW 624 +/- 80.2 kg (Cow agent 8.1).
bodyweight_mature_kg.description: Baseline body weight of a cow at or above herd.mature_parity. Daily energy balance moves body weight around this baseline within a lactation. Owner decision 2026-09-23.

initial_body_condition_score.description: Default body-condition score assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

mild_heat_stress_thi.description: THI threshold at which mild heat-stress effects begin.

severe_heat_stress_thi.description: THI threshold at which severe heat-stress effects begin.

mild_heat_stress_dmi_loss_fraction.description: DMI reduction applied in the mild THI band.

severe_heat_stress_dmi_loss_fraction.description: DMI reduction applied above the severe THI threshold.

mild_heat_stress_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction applied in the mild THI band.

severe_heat_stress_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction applied above the severe THI threshold.

sara_rumen_ph_threshold.description: Rumen pH below which subacute ruminal acidosis is tracked.

sara_consecutive_ticks.description: Consecutive low-pH observations required before SARA production effects apply.

sara_digestibility_loss_fraction.description: Diet digestibility reduction for cows with sustained SARA (blueprint 8.5: digestibility -10%); lowers effective ME, so FCR and CH4 per kg DMI worsen while intake is unchanged.

sara_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction applied to cows affected by sustained SARA.

ration_shortfall_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk-production reduction per unit of unmet prior-day ration coverage.

grazing_intake_kg_dm_per_ha_day.description: Dry-matter intake contribution from pasture grazing per hectare.

milk_protein_fraction.description: Milk protein mass per litre of simulated milk; workbook protein content (Excel values take precedence).

dmi_level_calibration_factor.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST AIRAND year 15 lactating-cow DMI (AT73 / AT21 = 26.2 kg/milking cow-day)
dmi_level_calibration_factor.description: Scales the NASEM Eq 2-1 intake level so lactating-cow dry-matter intake matches the workbook (Excel precedence); the equation form is unchanged. Refit 2026-09-24 from 1.19 after the per-cow ration-coverage fix.

heat_stress_conception_reduction_fractio.source: abm_blueprint.html section 8.4 (THI > 72 raises reproductive-failure probability; magnitude not clearly specified)
heat_stress_conception_reduction_fractio.description: Relative reduction of conception probability on days with THI above the severe heat-stress threshold.

eq2_1_max_dim_days.description: Days in milk beyond which NASEM Eq 2-1 is evaluated at its envelope limit (fallback).

dmi_stochastic_cv.description: Day-to-day stochastic variation of realised DMI around expected DMI.

initial_feed_inventory_kg_dm.description: Opening on-farm feed inventory when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_soil_n_kg.description: Opening plant-available soil nitrogen when a scenario does not provide one.

local_feed_crude_protein_fraction.description: Crude-protein fraction assigned to locally produced feed dry matter.

imported_feed_crude_protein_fraction.description: Crude-protein fraction assigned to imported feed dry matter.

metabolizable_protein_fraction_of_crude_.description: Share of ration crude protein represented as metabolizable protein.

nitrogen_fraction_of_crude_protein.description: Nitrogen mass fraction represented by ration crude protein.

ration_cost_per_kg_dm.description: Fallback lactating-cow ration price per kg dry matter when no market packet is present (workbook).

nutrient_return_efficiency.description: Fraction of manure nutrients credited back to crop production.

seasonal_yield_modifier.description: Seasonal multiplier on baseline crop yield; scenario can override per month.

catch_crop_n_leaching_fraction.description: Fraction of plant-available soil nitrogen lost to leaching per day.

amino_acid_cp_reduction_points.description: Absolute reduction in dietary crude-protein percentage when amino-acid balancing is active (1.5-2.5pp band, 2.0pp midpoint).

metabolizable_energy_mj_per_kg_dm_arid_g.description: ME initialization midpoint for arid grazing systems.

metabolizable_energy_mj_per_kg_dm_humid_.description: ME initialization midpoint for humid/temperate mixed systems.

metabolizable_energy_mj_per_kg_dm_high_i.description: ME initialization floor for high-intensity developed systems (>10.5).

seasonal_me_amplitude_fraction.description: Peak-to-baseline seasonal ME swing; sinusoidal form is an implementation choice because the blueprint does not specify the exact function.

neutral_detergent_fiber_fraction.description: Neutral-detergent fibre fraction of ration dry matter.

mp_requirement_fraction_of_dm.source: abm_blueprint.html section 2.5 mp_requirement_pct (value not clearly specified)
mp_requirement_fraction_of_dm.description: Metabolizable-protein requirement proxy as a share of DM, used in excess_N = (dietary CP - MP requirement) x DMI.

forage_ndf_pct_of_dm.source: implementation (diet composition not clearly specified in the blueprint)
forage_ndf_pct_of_dm.description: Forage NDF as percent of diet DM (fNDF) for NASEM Eq 2-2.

adf_to_ndf_ratio.source: implementation (diet composition not clearly specified in the blueprint)
adf_to_ndf_ratio.description: ADF as a fraction of diet NDF for NASEM Eq 2-2.

forage_ndf_digestibility_pct.description: Forage NDF digestibility (fNDFD) for NASEM Eq 2-2; blueprint fallback value.

digester_route_fraction.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) separator_liquid_fraction = 0.65 (docs/parity/conventional_dashboard_target.html DEFAULTS). The Blueprint (Manure agent 4.2) leaves the split to routing policy and the workbook has no manure data.
digester_route_fraction.description: Share of collected manure routed to anaerobic digestion (the separator liquid fraction). Used only while the L3 energy loop is on; otherwise this share goes to storage. Owner decision 2026-09-23.

compost_route_fraction.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) separator_solid_fraction = 0.35 (docs/parity/conventional_dashboard_target.html DEFAULTS). The Blueprint (Manure agent 4.2) leaves the split to routing policy and the workbook has no manure data.
compost_route_fraction.description: Share of collected manure routed to composting (the separator solid fraction). Used only while the L1 nutrient loop is on; otherwise this share goes to storage. Owner decision 2026-09-23.

storage_route_fraction.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset): the separator sends all treated manure to compost or digester (docs/parity/conventional_dashboard_target.html DEFAULTS manure_to_treatment_fraction = 1.0).
storage_route_fraction.description: Share of collected manure routed directly to storage. Storage also receives the digester or compost share when L3 or L1 is off, and any digester-capacity residual.

biochemical_methane_potential_m3_per_kg_.description: Biochemical methane potential for digested manure.

volatile_solids_fraction.description: Volatile solids fraction in wet manure.

collection_efficiency.description: Fraction of cow manure captured by the managed manure system.

storage_capacity_kg.description: Managed manure storage capacity used for inventory and overflow checks.

storage_release_fraction.description: Daily fraction of stored manure released from inventory; zero retains storage until a later policy path is added.

uncollected_ch4_kg_per_kg_manure.description: Methane loss factor for manure outside managed collection.

urinary_n_excess_fraction.description: Share of feed nitrogen above metabolizable-protein supply assigned to urinary nitrogen.

digestate_n_retention_fraction.description: Retained nitrogen fraction for the digester nutrient-return package.

compost_n_retention_fraction.description: Retained nitrogen fraction for the compost nutrient-return package.

phosphorus_to_nitrogen_fraction.description: Placeholder phosphorus-to-nitrogen ratio for route-specific nutrient packages.

potassium_to_nitrogen_fraction.description: Placeholder potassium-to-nitrogen ratio for route-specific nutrient packages.

thermochemical_route_fraction.description: Share of digester-routed manure diverted to the optional thermochemical route.

thermochemical_biochar_yield_fraction.description: Biochar yield retained as a physical reporting output until externally calibrated.

thermochemical_syngas_kwh_per_kg.description: Syngas energy yield retained as a physical reporting output until externally calibrated.

compost_product_yield_fraction.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) compost_kg_per_kg_manure_to_compost (not specified in the workbook or blueprint)
compost_product_yield_fraction.description: Finished compost mass per kg of manure routed to composting.

digestate_yield_fraction.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) digestate_kg_per_kg_manure_to_digester (not specified in the workbook or blueprint)
digestate_yield_fraction.description: Digestate mass leaving the digester per kg of feedstock.

compost_value_per_kg.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) compost_value_currency_per_kg (not specified in the workbook or blueprint)
compost_value_per_kg.description: Sale value of finished compost (L1 nutrient loop revenue).

l3_energy_loop_enabled.description: Enable biogas energy generation from digested manure.

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Static electricity value when no market packet is available.

heat_value_per_kwh.description: Value of recovered heat that displaces a configured farm heat demand (scenario farm_heat_demand_mj_per_day). The Blueprint (Energy agent 8.5, 2.7) specifies no heat demand, recovery fraction or heat price, so no demand is configured and heat is reported but not monetized (owner decision 2026-09-23).

parasitic_load_fraction.description: Fraction of generated energy consumed by system operation.

grid_offset_kg_co2e_per_kwh.description: Avoided grid emissions credit for exported electricity.

farm_energy_demand_kwh_per_day.source: implementation (no documented source: the Blueprint, Energy agent 8.2 and 9, requires external calibration of farm demand, and the workbook has no energy data)
farm_energy_demand_kwh_per_day.description: Farm electricity demand. Only generation up to this demand is monetized (displaced_grid_energy); the rest is reported as surplus_energy_kwh without value (Blueprint Energy agent 10). Kept as a labelled assumption by owner decision 2026-09-23.

heat_mj_per_kwh.description: Screening CHP heat-recovery coefficient derived as 3.6 MJ/kWh times 50 percent thermal efficiency divided by 38 percent electrical efficiency. Replace it with project-specific CHP performance before investment use.

solar_kw_per_cow.description: Optional solar capacity sizing per cow; the blueprint does not specify a per-cow value.

milk_loss_sick_fraction.description: Milk production reduction for sick cows.

transmission_daily_probability.description: Per-infected-cow daily transmission contribution in the simplified SIR model.

disease_mortality_daily_probability.description: Disease-specific mortality probability; zero until calibrated.

quarantine_enabled.description: Whether infected cows are flagged for quarantine.

quarantine_effectiveness_fraction.description: Reduction in infectious transmission contribution from quarantined cows.

biosecurity_effectiveness_fraction.description: Maximum transmission reduction applied by scenario biosecurity level.

vaccination_effectiveness_fraction.description: Reduction in infection probability for vaccinated cows.

inherited_resistance_effectiveness_fract.description: Additional reduction in infection probability per unit health trait above baseline.

stress_susceptibility_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to infection probability for cows under active stress (heat, SARA).

herd_density_transmission_multiplier.description: Multiplier on transmission pressure based on herd density relative to an operational reference. Values >1 amplify transmission in dense herds.

ch4_gwp100.description: Methane GWP100 factor used for reporting.

n2o_gwp100.description: Nitrous oxide GWP100 factor used for reporting.

field_n2o_kg_n2o_per_kg_n.description: Conversion of Manure field-N2O precursor into an Environment ledger stream.

fertilizer_n_kg_co2e_per_kg_n.description: Avoided-emission factor for recycled nitrogen displacing synthetic fertilizer.

circularity_weight_energy.description: Circularity score weight for energy recovery.

circularity_weight_nutrients.description: Circularity score weight for nutrient recycling.

circularity_weight_water.description: Circularity score weight for water reuse.

circularity_weight_products.description: Circularity score weight for by-product/product routing.

cofeed_safety_approved.description: Allow safety-approved co-feed inputs to manure energy routes.

coproduct_feed_allowed.description: Allow dairy coproducts to return to the feed system.

thermochemical_route_active.description: Enable optional thermochemical manure valorization routes.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate for ROI calculations.

carbon_credit_price_per_tonne_co2e.description: Optional carbon credit price; zero by default.

objective_weight_profit.description: Farm-manager objective weight for profit maximisation.

objective_weight_environment.description: Farm-manager objective weight for environmental performance.

objective_weight_animal_welfare.description: Farm-manager objective weight for animal health and welfare.

objective_weight_circularity.description: Farm-manager objective weight for circular-economy performance.

analysis_horizon_years.description: Investment horizon required by the symposium abstract.

l1_nutrient_base_capex.description: Screening capital basis using the FY2026 NRCS nutrient-management design base cost; not a vendor quote.

l1_nutrient_capex_per_acre.description: Screening capital basis using the FY2026 NRCS nutrient-management implementation cost per acre.

l2_water_base_capex.description: Lower-bound screening basis using the FY2026 NRCS wastewater screw-pump base cost; treatment and storage must be supplied through an override when required.

l3_energy_base_capex.description: Screening capital basis using the FY2026 NRCS modular biodigester cost.

l3_energy_capex_per_animal_unit.description: Screening capital basis using the FY2026 NRCS covered-lagoon or holding-pond cost per animal unit.

l4_processing_capex_per_cow.description: Screening equipment-only basis derived from a documented 198260 currency artisan-cheese equipment cost for a 210-cow farm; excludes land and building.

alert_sensitivity.description: Threshold for converting abnormal readings into alerts.

missing_reading_probability.description: Daily probability of a missing sensor reading.

ambient_temperature_c.description: Fallback ambient temperature when no scenario weather input is supplied.

relative_humidity_pct.description: Fallback relative humidity when no scenario weather input is supplied.

rumen_ph_baseline.description: Fallback rumen-pH reading when no bolus value is supplied.

bolus_replacement_ticks.description: Bolus age at which replacement is due within the blueprint's 80-90 tick guidance.

sara_consecutive_ticks.description: Consecutive low-pH readings required for a sensor SARA-risk flag.

estrus_activity_threshold.description: Activity threshold used by the simplified estrus detector.

estrus_rumination_change_threshold.description: Rumination-change threshold used by the simplified estrus detector.

nir_crude_protein_fraction.description: Fallback NIR crude-protein profile used when no external feed scan is supplied.

thermal_mastitis_alert_confidence.description: Minimum blueprint-supported confidence for optional thermal mastitis alerts.

rumination_baseline_minutes_per_day.description: Baseline daily rumination time per cow.

nir_seasonality_modifier_fraction.description: Seasonal adjustment to NIR feed CP fraction; zero denotes no seasonality.

l2_water_loop_enabled.description: Enable recovered-water credits for next-day irrigation demand.

treatment_recovery_fraction.description: Fraction of wastewater recovered for reuse.

treatment_active.description: Enable on-farm wastewater treatment and physical reuse reporting.

wastewater_return_fraction.description: Share of parlor cleaning-water demand collected as treatable wastewater; kept separate from the amino-acid whole-farm water adjustment.

amino_acid_policy_active_default.description: Preserves the existing baseline water-saving assumption unless a scenario overrides amino-acid policy activity.

nutrient_recovery_enabled.description: Publish optional wastewater nutrient-recovery packets when an external recovery coefficient is configured.

nutrient_recovery_kg_n_per_l.description: Optional nutrient-recovery coefficient; zero denotes unavailable external calibration.

water_loop_fresh_water_offset_fraction.description: Share of recovered water credited against next-day freshwater irrigation demand.

l4_byproduct_loop_enabled.description: Enable whey-derived feed credits for the following day.

enabled.description: Processor route is off by default while the agent remains available.

whey_processing_enabled.description: Whey route is off by default.

product_mix_cheese.description: Default product mix share for cheese.

product_mix_butter.description: Default product mix share for butter.

product_mix_yogurt.description: Default product mix share for yogurt.

product_mix_fresh.description: Default product mix share for fresh milk.

product_mix_functional.description: Default product mix share for functional products.

processing_energy_kwh_per_l_milk.description: Processor energy use when processor route is enabled.

milk_cooling_kwh_per_l_milk.description: Bulk-tank cooling energy for all harvested milk.

fraction_milk_to_processor.description: Share of harvested milk entering the opted-in processor.

whey_yield_cheese.description: Whey generated by the cheese milk stream.

whey_yield_yogurt.description: Whey generated by the yogurt milk stream.

whey_yield_functional.description: Whey generated by the functional milk stream.

fraction_sludge_of_milk.description: Processor sludge generated per litre of processed milk.

fraction_waste_milk_of_milk.description: Waste milk generated per litre of processed milk.

price_per_l_milk_cheese.description: Static cheese-stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_butter.description: Static butter-stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_yogurt.description: Static yogurt-stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_fresh.description: Static fresh-milk stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_functional.description: Static functional-product stream value when a product price packet is absent.

whey_liquid_price_per_l.description: Value booked for safety-approved liquid whey feed return.

fraction_whey_to_feed.description: Share of whey routed to the animal-feed loop when enabled.

fraction_sludge_to_energy.description: Share of processor sludge routed to energy.

fraction_waste_milk_to_feed.description: Share of waste milk routed to feed when safety allows.

milk_snf_fraction.description: Skim (non-fat) solids content of processed milk for the component ledger.

butter_yield_kg_per_kg_milk.unit: kg butter/kg milk routed to butter
butter_yield_kg_per_kg_milk.source: implementation (plant yields are not clearly specified in the blueprint)
butter_yield_kg_per_kg_milk.description: Butter output per kg of milk routed to the butter stream, used with the USDA ERS fat/SNF draws.

cheese_yield_kg_per_kg_milk.unit: kg cheese/kg milk routed to cheese
cheese_yield_kg_per_kg_milk.source: implementation (plant yields are not clearly specified in the blueprint)
cheese_yield_kg_per_kg_milk.description: American-type cheese output per kg of milk routed to cheese.

dry_whey_yield_kg_per_kg_whey.source: implementation (plant yields are not clearly specified in the blueprint)
dry_whey_yield_kg_per_kg_whey.description: Dry whey solids recoverable per kg of liquid whey.

milk_price_per_l.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST!BV12:BV15 component prices at the workbook fat, protein and SCS levels, x 1.03 kg/L
milk_price_per_l.description: Milk-equivalent price per litre implied by the workbook component prices; used where a single litre price is needed (processor raw-milk value). Herd milk revenue uses the component prices directly.

feed_cost_per_kg_dm.description: Lactating-cow ration price per kg dry matter (workbook). Dry-cow DM uses cdairy_economics.dmi_dry_price_per_kg.

price_shock_stddev_fraction.description: Optional stochastic price shock standard deviation; disabled by default.

class_cwt_to_l_conversion.description: Explicit conversion placeholder for class price to volume price; must be validated before use.

silvopastoral_tree_cover_fraction.description: Dashboard range for silvopastoral tree cover.

soil_carbon_sequestration_index.description: Dashboard range for soil-carbon sequestration index.

monthly_report_day.description: Monthly reports emit on calendar month end.

annual_genetics_day.description: Annual genetics cycle emits on calendar year end.

profit_deviation_adjustment.description: Adjustment_ProfitDeviation (multiplier on the calf, heifer, profit-deviation and embryo revenue rows). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

milk_price_per_kg.description: Milk price per kg milk. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

fat_price_per_kg.description: Fat price per kg fat. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

protein_price_per_kg.description: Protein price per kg protein. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

scs_penalty.unit: currency per thousand SCC per kg milk
scs_penalty.description: SCS penalty coefficient applied to SCC deviation (thousand cells/mL) x milk kg. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

cull_cow_value.description: Cull cow value per head. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

bull_calf_value.description: Sold bull calf base value per head. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

female_calf_value.description: Sold heifer calf value per head (female calf, cull value). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

dmi_wet_price_per_kg.description: Feed price per kg dry matter, lactating (wet) cow. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

dmi_dry_price_per_kg.description: Feed price per kg dry matter, dry cow and heifer. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

presynch_cost.description: Presynch protocol cost. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

firstsynch_cost.description: Firstsynch protocol cost. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

resynch_f_cost.description: ResynchF cost (usually GnRH). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

resynch_s_cost.description: ResynchS cost (usually PGF). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

pregnancy_diagnosis_1_cost.description: Pregnancy diagnosis 1 (early blood test). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

pregnancy_diagnosis_2_cost.description: Pregnancy diagnosis 2. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

pregnancy_diagnosis_3_cost.description: Pregnancy diagnosis 3. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

pregnancy_diagnosis_4_cost.description: Pregnancy diagnosis 4. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

ai_cost.description: Conventional semen insemination. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

sexed_semen_cost.description: Sexed semen insemination. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

donor_cow_cost.description: Embryo donor cost per cow. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

donor_heifer_cost.description: Embryo donor cost per heifer. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

fresh_embryo_cost.description: Fresh embryo production and transfer. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

frozen_embryo_cost.description: Frozen embryo production and transfer. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

vwp_cow_day_cost.description: Cost per VWP cow-day (calving to VWP). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

eligible_cow_day_cost.description: Cost per eligible cow-day (VWP to DNB). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

dnb_cow_day_cost.description: Cost per DNB cow-day (DNB to culling). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

pregnant_wet_cow_day_cost.description: Cost per pregnant wet cow-day (conception to dry-off). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

milking_cow_day_cost.description: Other variable cost per milking cow-day. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

dry_cow_day_cost.description: Other variable cost per dry cow-day. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

replacement_heifer_cost.description: Replacement heifer purchase cost used by the heifer-purchased cost row (Tables!C25 lists 2000; the live formula uses this cell). Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

fixed_cost_per_cow_day.description: Fixed cost per cow (stall) per day. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

genomic_testing_cost.description: Genomic testing cost per test. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

heifer_raising_cost_per_day.description: Heifer raising cost per heifer-day. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

cull_price_per_kg.description: Cull price per kg body weight. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

heat_detection_cost_per_cow_day.description: Heat detection labour per eligible cow-day. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

heat_detection_cost_per_heifer_day.description: Heat detection labour per eligible heifer-day. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

extra_embryo_sale_price.description: Extra embryo sale price. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

gram_positive_mastitis_cost.description: Gram-positive clinical mastitis treatment cost per case. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

gram_negative_mastitis_cost.description: Gram-negative clinical mastitis treatment cost per case. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

other_mastitis_cost.description: Other clinical mastitis treatment cost per case. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

dry_cow_therapy_cost.description: Blanket dry cow therapy antibiotic cost per dry period. Workbook value; Excel formulas take precedence over other sources.

vwp_cows_days.description: Voluntary waiting period after calving before cows are eligible for insemination.

ovulation_interval_low_days.description: Lower truncation of the interval between ovulations.

ovulation_interval_mean_days.description: Mean interval between ovulations (estrous cycle length).

ovulation_interval_high_days.description: Upper truncation of the interval between ovulations.

ovulation_interval_std_days.description: Standard deviation of the interval between ovulations.

pr_insemination_at_estrus_cows.description: Probability a cow in estrus is detected and inseminated.

pr_insemination_at_estrus_heifers.description: Probability a heifer in estrus is detected and inseminated.

pr_conception_estrus_cows.description: Base probability of conception per insemination at estrus (cows).

pr_conception_estrus_heifers.description: Base probability of conception per insemination at estrus (heifers).

conception_genetic_multiplier_cows.description: Fertility improvement from 15 years of genetic selection in the herd program, calibrated so cow conception rate matches Stats_MAST!BQ65.

conception_genetic_multiplier_heifers.description: Fertility improvement from genetic selection, calibrated so heifer conception rate matches Stats_MAST!BQ108.

estrus_expression_probability.description: Probability an ovulation is accompanied by observable estrus; calibrated to the 21-day service rate (Stats_MAST!BQ57).

pregcheck_2_days.description: Day of the second pregnancy diagnosis (the first, pregcheck(1), is disabled with -1).

pregcheck_3_days.description: Day of the third pregnancy diagnosis.

pregcheck_4_days.description: Day of the fourth pregnancy diagnosis.

gestation_days.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) hidden default gestation_days; consistent with Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm Stats_MAST intercalving interval minus days open

dry_period_days.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, herdInputs!AG2 pregcheck(4) = 220 d; with 283-d gestation cows are dried off at the last pregnancy check (workbook dry cow-days per cow match a 63-d dry period)

dry_cow_dmi_kg_per_day.description: Dry-matter intake of a dry cow.

cull_milk_threshold_kg_per_day.description: Do-not-breed cows are culled once daily milk falls below this level.

do_not_breed_after_dim_days.description: Open cows past this DIM are marked do-not-breed; with the cull-milk rule this reproduces the workbook average DNB cull DIM (Stats_MAST!BQ77, 424 d).

max_parity.description: Cows completing this lactation are culled at dry-off (workbook "end of last parity" culling).

pregnancy_loss_probability_cows.description: Pregnancy loss between the first and last pregnancy check (cows).

pregnancy_loss_probability_heifers.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST AIRAND year 15 raw rows 358/53 (heifer abortions / heifer conceptions)
pregnancy_loss_probability_heifers.description: Pregnancy loss between the first and last pregnancy check (heifers).

cow_death_rate_annual.description: Involuntary on-farm death rate of adult cows.

cow_involuntary_cull_rate_annual.description: Involuntary live culling rate of adult cows (sold at cull cow value).

heifer_involuntary_cull_rate_annual.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST AIRAND year 15 raw rows 169+175 / present heifers
heifer_involuntary_cull_rate_annual.description: Heifer involuntary live culling rate (sold by body weight).

heifer_breeding_age_days.description: Age at which heifers become eligible for insemination; calibrated to age at first calving (Stats_MAST!BQ95, 735 d). herdInputs!BM2 lists vwp(heifers)=305, which does not reproduce the workbook first-calving age.

barren_heifer_cull_age_days.description: Heifers still open at this age are culled as barren (workbook culled(12)).

female_calf_sale_age_days.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Tables!B34 note 2 (sale at 105 d of age)
female_calf_sale_age_days.description: Age at which surplus female calves are sold.

female_calf_sale_fraction.description: Share of female calves sold as surplus under random calf selection.

stillbirth_fraction.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST AIRAND year 15 (1 - calves born / calvings, BQ83/BQ84)
stillbirth_fraction.description: Calvings that yield no live calf.

male_calf_fraction.description: Share of live calves that are male (sold as bull calves).

heifer_growth_kg_per_day.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) bodyweight_first_parity_kg 540 at the workbook first-calving age
heifer_growth_kg_per_day.description: Average heifer growth rate from birth to first calving.

initial_heifers_per_cow.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST AIRAND year 15 (present heifer days / present cow days)
initial_heifers_per_cow.description: Replacement heifers present at the start of a generated herd.

clinical_mastitis_incidence_parity4plus.description: Clinical mastitis incidence, fourth and later lactations.

mastitis_gram_positive_share.description: Share of clinical cases caused by gram-positive pathogens.

mastitis_gram_negative_share.description: Share of clinical cases caused by gram-negative pathogens (the rest are other / no growth).

antibiotic_daily_doses_per_gram_positive.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST agg row 587 equals 5 x gram-positive cases in every year and strategy
antibiotic_daily_doses_per_gram_positive.description: Antibiotic daily doses per treated gram-positive clinical case (only gram-positive cases receive antibiotics, Tables!B36).

average_scs.description: Herd average test-day somatic cell score used by the SCS premium/penalty row; not simulated dynamically.

profit_deviation_cows_per_cow_year.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST!BQ23 (herd-program genetic profit deviation; exogenous, not simulated)
profit_deviation_cows_per_cow_year.description: Genetic profit deviation of cows, taken from the workbook because its herd-program formula is not available.

profit_deviation_heifers_per_cow_year.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST!BQ25 (herd-program genetic profit deviation; exogenous, not simulated)
profit_deviation_heifers_per_cow_year.description: Genetic profit deviation of heifers, taken from the workbook because its herd-program formula is not available.

replacement_purchase_threshold_fraction.description: Replacement heifers are purchased when adult cows fall below this share of herd capacity.

wood_b.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) wood_b (Wood's curve rise to peak)
wood_b.description: Wood's lactation curve shape parameter b (the blueprint does not specify a lactation equation).

wood_c.source: Dairy_bioeconomy_dashboard.html (Conventional preset) wood_c (Wood's curve post-peak decline)
wood_c.description: Wood's lactation curve shape parameter c.

peak_milk_l_first_parity.description: Peak daily milk of a first-lactation cow before the herd yield scale.

peak_milk_l_mature.description: Peak daily milk of a mature cow before the herd yield scale.

mature_parity.description: Parity at which peak milk reaches the mature level (linear in between).

milk_yield_scale.description: Scale applied to the dashboard Wood's peaks so herd milk per cow-year matches the workbook. Refit 2026-09-24 from 1.368 after the per-cow ration-coverage fix.

cow_peak_std_fraction.description: Cow-to-cow standard deviation of the lactation peak.

first_service_submission_probability.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, Stats_MAST AIRAND year 15 (calibration target: days to first service BQ73)
first_service_submission_probability.description: Probability that the first estrus after the VWP leads to a first insemination; repeat services use estrus expression x pr_insemination_at_estrus.

reproduction_rate_eligibility_start_dim.source: Cdairy_mc_kk_current_PS_CM_Strategies.xlsm, herdInputs!M2 firstsynch_dim = 50; Stats_MAST days open minus eligible days per conception is 45-54 d in years 0-15
reproduction_rate_eligibility_start_dim.description: DIM from which cow-days count as eligible in the 21-day service- and pregnancy-rate statistics, reproducing the workbook definition (the VWP for breeding remains vwp_cows_days).
